title: Essential: Pump strokes
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the number of pump strokes required as 48.

title: Essential: Disinfectant outcome
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that no disinfectant remains in the cylinder after spraying.

title: Essential: Gas mass fraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the fraction of the original gas mass that was sprayed out as 1/3.

title: Important: Boyle's Law application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Boyle's Law (pV = constant) to relate pressures and volumes for the gas in the barrel.

title: Important: Volume accounting
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly account for the initial 3L of air in the barrel and the 0.25L per pump stroke.

title: Important: Final gas expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the final expanded volume of the 5 atm gas at 1 atm (15L) and compare it to the tank's total volume (10L).

title: Optional: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm³ to L) throughout the solution.

title: Pitfall: Ignoring initial air
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assumes the barrel starts with zero air, neglecting the initial 3L volume.

title: Pitfall: Misapplying gas laws
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses an ideal gas law other than Boyle's Law (e.g., Charles's Law) for this isothermal process.
